source_title: Karan Johar picks favourite looks from Ranbir Kapoor's and Shah Rukh Khan's films
source_excerpt: Filmmaker Karan Johar has revealed the on-screen looks from his movies that continue to impress him. He named Ranbir Kapoor's Ayan Sanger from 'Ae Dil Hai Mushkil' and Shah Rukh Khan's Dev Saran from 'Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna' as his personal favourites. The director discussed his fashion preferences, treasured accessories and views on celebrity style in an interview with Variety.Karan Johar's own fashion choices have changed considerably over the years. His style has moved from monochromatic outfits to sequinned and more elaborate looks. More recently, he has shown an interest in understated luxury.
